unit.why: A bibliographic and homiletic note on a passage in the son's introduction to Noam Elimelech, praising the Rebbe Elimelech's self-sacrifice for Israel, with the author's father insisting that printers keep it; it reports an opinion and an instruction rather than a narrated event.
unit.boundary_note: Part of an alphabetical compilation (entry nun, 'on the book Noam Elimelech'); the next division continues the same entry.
